news.title: Siddharth Khanna and Nitin Singrodia acquired an unknown majority stake in Tbk Samiyaz Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited from Prism Johnson Limited (BSE:500338) for INR .65 million.
news.body:
Siddharth Khanna and Nitin Singrodia acquired an unknown majority stake in Tbk Samiyaz Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited from Prism Johnson Limited (BSE:500338) for INR .65 million on March 30, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 0.65 million will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 0.65 million is paid towards common equity of Tbk Samiyaz Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited.

news.title: QBE Holdings (AAP) Pty Limited entered into Share Purchase Agreement to acquire remaining 51% stake in Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited from Prism Johnson Limited (BSE:500338) for INR 3.2 billion.
news.body:
QBE Holdings (AAP) Pty Limited entered into Share Purchase Agreement to acquire remaining 51% stake in Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited from Prism Johnson Limited (BSE:500338) for INR 3.2 billion on March 2, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 3.24 billion will be paid by QBE Holdings (AAP) Pty Limited. Upon completion, QBE Holdings (AAP) Pty Limited will own 100% stake in Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited.

The transaction has been approved by the board of Prism Johnson Limited. The completion of the proposed transaction is subject to completion of the conditions precedent set out in the Share Purchase Agreement, including receipt of requisite approvals, including approval of the shareholders of Prism Johnson Limited and approval of the IRDAI. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.21 (vs ₹0.96 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.21 (up from ₹0.96 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹18.5b (flat on 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹611.2m (up 27% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.3% (up from 2.6% in 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 4.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Basic Materials industry in India are expected to remain flat. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 47% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 4.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 17% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns.
